Massive credit to Italy, who played their hearts out. USA will look to rebound from a lackluster performance tomorrow against Czechia

items.title: USAW escapes Group Play Game No. 2 with a 55-52 win over Italy. Nothing went well for them today, but they clinch a spot in the quarterfinals.
items.author: Scott Agness
items.body_excerpt:
USAW escapes Group Play Game No. 2 with a 55-52 win over Italy. Nothing went well for them today, but they clinch a spot in the quarterfinals.

Jackie Young scored 10, Reese had 8/3. Boston added 6/3 and closed the game.

Next: Mon. v Czechia (2:45 p.m. ET)
